verdict.rationale: The evidence shows three.js ships production WebGL and WebGPU renderers and node-based materials such as MeshStandardNodeMaterial, which suggests a standard (PBR-style) material path, though PBR is never stated explicitly. Nothing in the pack documents shadows, post-processing, or global illumination or baked lighting, and a community user only asks whether lightmaps can be generated. missing for 10: explicit PBR material documentation, shadow support evidence, post-processing pipeline evidence, global illumination or baked lightmap support, independent hands-on corroboration of render quality.
